Zanzibar Marine Fees Explained

When booking Zanzibar tours and activities, marine park fees are a standard component. Here's what you need to know:

  • Mnemba Atoll Marine Park: $20–25 per person, includes snorkeling access
  • Chumbe Island Coral Park: $65–75 per person, includes guided tour and protected area fee
  • Zanzibar National Park (Jozani Forest): $30 per person, includes guided walk
  • Conservation levy: Typically $10–15 per vehicle for mainland excursions

All licensed Zanzibar tour operators include these fees in their quoted prices. Ensure your chosen operator is transparent about what's included.
